# Enhanced Enums

enum Color {
  red(1),
  blue(2);
  final int value;
  const Color(this.value);
}

==>

Program(
  Declaration(
    EnumDeclaration(
      enum,
      Identifier,
      "{",
      EnumBody(
        EnumEntry(Identifier, ArgumentList("(", Literal(NumberLiteral), ")")),
        ",",
        EnumEntry(Identifier, ArgumentList("(", Literal(NumberLiteral), ")")),
        ";",
        MemberDeclaration(VariableDeclaration(final, Type(TypeNoQuestion(TypeIdentifier(Identifier))), Identifier)),
        MemberDeclaration(ConstructorDeclaration(const, Identifier, "(", ParameterList(Parameter(this, ".", Identifier)), ")", ";"))
      ),
      "}"
    )
  )
)

# Multiple Extends (Graceful Degradation)

abstract class Foo extends Bar1, Bar2, Bar3 implements Baz {}

==>

Program(
  Declaration(
    ClassDeclaration(
      abstract,
      class,
      Identifier,
      extends,
      TypeList(
        Type(TypeNoQuestion(TypeIdentifier(Identifier))),
        ",",
        Type(TypeNoQuestion(TypeIdentifier(Identifier))),
        ",",
        Type(TypeNoQuestion(TypeIdentifier(Identifier)))
      ),
      implements,
      TypeList(Type(TypeNoQuestion(TypeIdentifier(Identifier)))),
      ClassBody("{", "}")
    )
  )
)
